title: Angel Heart
note: mentioned during Star Wars and Die Hard with a Vengeance eps; was one of the options in the vote for the final movie of CR month
plot: A down-and-out Brooklyn detective is hired to track down a singer on an odyssey that will take him through the desperate streets of Harlem, the smoke-filled jazz clubs of New Orleans, and the swamps of Louisiana and its seedy underworld of voodoo.
